text: Follow-ups from re-reading the post-3.0.1 fixes: merge-confirm race, reserved literals, comment

Landed in 408e774. Correction to the ticket text: the view model takes its category order as a one-time snapshot, so a sync cannot reorder it under an open dialog — the index race was not reachable that way. The user's own move-up/move-down controls can still move rows, so the by-name resolution is kept and tested through those. Also found during the gate: the same leaked-view-model flake T-252 fixed in ListViewModelTest, here in ListPropsViewModelTest (a one-in-a-suite 1-minute timeout on the notification-toggle test, clean on rerun); fixed the same way. Full gate green after.
